pages.name: Soul Bee
pages.text: Bubba Star. Nether, all the time.

Rarely brings home a sad comb, which makes ghast tears and goes into crying obsidian and wither roses.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Soul Sand, Soul Soil$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() Soul Sand Valley$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Soul Honeycomb: the other trips, 200 per hive-hour$(li)Sad Honeycomb: rare, 1 in 20, 10.5 per hive-hour
$(l)Fire-immune:$() Fire and lava don't hurt it.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
